name: Telpen Adverts (Sell Find Connect)
install: npm ci && npm run db:generate && npm run build:domain

terminals.name: dev
terminals.description: Runs the NestJS API (http://localhost:4000/v1, OpenAPI docs at /docs) and the Next.js web app (http://localhost:3000) together with hot reload. Uses in-memory persistence by default; set PERSISTENCE_DRIVER=prisma with DATABASE_URL to overlay PostgreSQL.
